note: Domain dispositions are explicit model semantic intent and remain distinct from input_fate bookkeeping. Runtime owns accountable_set and validates/reconciles every declared disposition against changes, state_patch, trace and the frozen snapshot; model declarations never bypass mutation/policy validation.
transformation_stage_constraints: runtime resolves accountable_set before model call
each accountable input appears exactly once in dispositions
no foreign disposition input_ref is allowed
declared disposition and actual changes/input_fate must reconcile without ambiguity
annotations and narrative are never disposition sources
commit_condition: accountable_set == declared_disposition_inputs AND foreign==0 AND duplicates==0 AND reconciliation_errors==0

reconciliation_rules.require: input remains represented without MERGE/SPLIT/SUPERSEDE/REJECT/DEFER conflict; UPDATE/REVISE of the same semantic identity is allowed
a MERGE change contains input_ref in source_refs and at least one declared result_temp_id equals the MERGE temp_id
at least two distinct result_temp_ids exist and each resolves to an allowed successor change with lineage to input_ref
a SUPERSEDE change targets input_ref; result_temp_ids, when present, resolve to the replacement proposal
an UPDATE targeting input_ref proposes state_patch.status=DEFERRED and the transition is permitted by stage/policy
input_fate is REJECTED, contract permits rejection, and no surviving successor preserves the input identity

input_fate_cross_checks: CONSUMED and NOT_USED never satisfy transformation coverage
TRANSFORMED must reconcile with MERGE/SPLIT or a stage-allowed transforming update
PRESERVED must not reconcile with terminal removal actions
